name: Arc TV
subtitle: Your IPTV, beautifully organised
description: Arc TV is a free player for the live TV, movies and series from your own IPTV provider. It does not include any channels or playlists.

apps.name: Arc TV
apps.subtitle: Your IPTV, beautifully organised
apps.localizedDescription: Watch live TV, movies and series from your own Stalker portal, with an Apple TV look: resume points, offline downloads, AirPlay, and backup import and export.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Arc TV 2.5.0 for iPhone

- **Up Next.** When an episode ends, Continue plays the next one, with its code and title on screen.
- **Subtitles when a video has none.** With SubDL on, Arc TV can look for an English subtitle for you as you play
  (the switch for it lives in Settings); you can also search for one and pick the release that fits. Cached
  subtitles keep working after the update, and two seasons with the same name no longer share the wrong file.
- **The right season, every time.** A series now opens on the season you were watching rather than the first.
- **Back up and restore** your portals and settings from Settings.

# Arc TV 2.0.2 (Android and iPhone)

2.0.2 is a small update for the phones.

## What is new

- **Restoring a Mac backup tells you about radio favorites.** The phones cannot play radio yet, so those favorites are skipped. The summary now says how many were skipped instead of dropping them silently.
- **Series match better when the season comes first.** Titles like "2 сезон" or "2nd Season" before or after the name are now understood, and non-English letters are kept when searching.
- **Plainer words.** "Source" instead of "portal" in setup, and one spelling of "favorites" everywhere.

## What did not change

- Your sources, favorites, history, backups, downloads and settings are untouched.
- The Mac app is on 2.2.8.

**What's new in 2.0.1**

- **Choose how many titles the library index keeps:** 1,000, 5,000 (the default), 10,000, 25,000, 50,000 or 100,000. Pick it when you turn the index on, or later under *Title limit* in Settings → Library & details → Title details (TMDB) → Library index.
- **Each choice shows how long a full run takes.** Raising the limit continues where the index stopped. Lowering it keeps the titles already stored; Delete index frees the space.
- **Nothing changes unless you change it.** The default stays at 5,000 and the index stays off until you start it.

The Mac app stays on 2.0.0.

Arc TV 2.0 for iPhone and iPad (early access): Browse by genre with an optional library index, the same new backup file as the Mac (optional passphrase for passwords and your TMDB key), an optional sync folder (Settings → Sync), Up Next, sleep timer, channel schedule, adult-content PIN and accessibility improvements. Update through SideStore.

**Fix: series open as series.** Titles from the Series tab, Home's New Series shelf and Search now open with their episode list, not as single movies.

- **Download all** is now a labelled button on a series.
- Switches in Settings are easy to read again, and **Check for updates** shows its result.
- The first screen has clear **Portal address** and **MAC address** labels with a short explanation.

Series you saved before this update may still appear under Movies in your Library.

**Design polish across the app.**

- Posters show their title on two lines and the year, so similar titles are easy to tell apart.
- The status bar stays readable over bright artwork, and the Movies, Series, Live TV and Search titles sit right under it.
- Detail has labelled **My List** and **Download** buttons, shows how much is left when you resume, and no longer has the tab bar over the text.
- Search keeps your typing lowercase and remembers your recent searches.
- Live Now cards are more compact, channel rows show their channel number, and portal names read in normal capitals.
- Update notes show as plain text, and large text sizes wrap cleanly.

**Fixes and polish:** watch progress is now kept per season (episode 1 of season 2 no longer overwrites episode 1 of season 1). Settings is simpler: five clear sections and a "Show advanced settings" switch. The player is easier to use on a phone: a roomier title, one More menu, a clean failed-playback screen, a seek bar that screen readers can use. Search says so when the network failed instead of "No results", episodes get a Try Again button, poster grids fill the screen evenly, text is easier to read, and error messages are in plain words.

**Fix:** shows whose portal lists a season in pages now show every episode. Some portals send 14 at a time, newest first, so the oldest episodes (like Season 1 Episode 1) were missing; the same applies to shows with many seasons.

**Arc TV for iPhone and iPad** 0.2.29 (early access). Requires iOS 18 or newer.

**What's new:** Arc TV now tells you when a new version is out (**Settings → Updates**) and opens SideStore to install it,
with a one-tap **Add Arc TV to SideStore**. Also in this build: portal export, per-season downloads, live channels in
Search, and a Series tab with its own categories.
